caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate, classical-style urn rendered in shades of black and gray pencil on a beige background. The urn sits on a high pedestal with a detailed base adorned with symmetrical designs, including garlands, scrollwork, and textured surfaces. The urn itself has a fluted lower portion and elaborate, scrolling handles on each side, decorated with floral motifs and curls. The composition is centered on the urn and its elaborate base, with the shading on the urn and base creating a three-dimensional effect. To the left of the urn, there is a smaller, lightly sketched outline of another vase with two tall, thin decorative elements inside it, which is rendered without shading and detail, making it appear faint compared to the main urn. The overall arrangement emphasizes the large urn as the primary subject and positions the smaller vase in the background for contrast.
title: Cast Iron Urn
